## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Adhikaraṇabheda* ("Various aspects of the four kinds of legal issues") is a chapter of the *Parivāra*, the fifth book of the Pali Vinaya Piṭaka. The text presents an exhaustive classification and analysis of the four types of legal questions or issues (*adhikaraṇa*): disputes, censure, offences, and obligations/duties [Horner 1966]. According to I. B. Horner, it forms the most thorough and detailed statement of the four legal issues found anywhere in the Vinaya Piṭaka, occupying its entire length without digression [Horner 1966]. In addition, the text analyses the seven procedures used for settling disciplinary matters.

 Complete English translations have been published by I. B. Horner (as Chapter IX of the *Parivāra* in *The Book of the Discipline*, vol. 6) and Bhikkhu Brahmali [Horner 1966].
